rca of the issue: fmtEUR uses fr-BE Intl.NumberFormat producing 'x,yz' (virgule). Using +fmtEUR(number) coerced 'x,yz' string via unary plus which returns NaN. This NaN silently propagated in useMemo return objects so total_called/total_paid/balance/remainingOnCurrent/totalCalledQuarter/totalPaidQuarter/totalCredit-Debit-net all rendered as 0,00 EUR (or picked wrong FIFO call because remainingOnCurrent was NaN and comparison 'NaN < amount - 0.01' is false, so is_partial_covered wrongly false and cumul logic never advanced past T1). Fix: replace +fmtEUR(x) with Math.round(x*100)/100 - keeps numeric type, rounds to 2 decimals equivalent to display precision, no locale round-trip. Verified: TOTAL APPELE 2103,74 / TOTAL PAYE 675,86 / SOLDE 1427,88 debiteur / Prochain paiement Trimestriel 2/4 475,94 EUR.
